title: Test/CI environment referenced in source
why_flagged: Source code can alter behavior when it detects a test runner or CI.
legit_if: Detection configures isolated resources, timeouts or legitimate environment settings.

title: Catch handler discards failures
why_flagged: A broad exception handler silently converts failures into apparent success.
legit_if: The operation is best effort, and discarding this failure is intentional.
